newsitem.title: USA: Norwest sees FY97 EPS in range of consensus.
newsitem.headline: Norwest sees FY97 EPS in range of consensus.

text.p: Norwest Corp chief executive officer Richard Kovacevich said Tuesday he expects 1997 earnings per share will be in a range around the First Call mean estimate of $3.50 a share.
"That is in the ballpark, plus or minus five cents," he said.
Kovacevich said excluding acquisitions he expected 1997 credit losses to be about equal to four-times the first-quarter losses of $112 million.
Net credit losses in 1996 amounted to $382.4 million.
"The losses are slowing. We're at or pretty close to the peak for us," Kovacevich said.
He added that Norwest began tightening its credit policy about 18 months ago, particularly on the consumer finance side.
